_doc: Hand rulings that win over whatever the model produced. Keyed by SOURCE string. Applied by tools/build.py after the model pass and honoured by tools/qa.py, so a fix here survives a --retranslate. Every entry carries its reason.

デフォルト_余韻.why: Same source translated two ways ('Default Afterglow' / 'Default_Afterglow') because it is set on two separate dropdowns. Resolved to the spaced form by corpus majority: every sibling label in these dropdowns ('Default Override', 'Default Expression', 'Expression Override 01') uses spaces.

デフォルト_喘ぎ絶頂.why: Same conflict, same resolution. The author's underscore is a field separator, not punctuation the player should see.
